products.title: BELIEVE
products.body_html:
The second sweatshirt Sneh sir wore at Live Like Krishna. Everything Krishna said on that battlefield comes down to one word — shraddha. Believe. Metallic gold print, the peacock feather standing in for the I, the flute beneath it, on 250 GSM, 100% combed cotton. Petrol blue as worn on stage, or black. Made once, in a small edition, for the people who were in the room. Not sold anywhere else. Never reprinted.

250 GSM, 100% combed cotton · relaxed fit, go one size up if between sizes · prepaid only · dispatch within 2 working days.

products.title: SURRENDER. SMILE. RISE.
products.body_html:
The sweatshirt Sneh sir wore on stage at Live Like Krishna. In the Gita, Arjuna dropped his bow — he surrendered. Krishna smiled. Then he told him one thing: rise. Three words, one story, printed in white on 250 GSM, 100% combed cotton. Navy as worn on stage, or black. Made once, in a small edition, for the people who were in the room. Not sold anywhere else. Never reprinted.

250 GSM, 100% combed cotton · relaxed fit, go one size up if between sizes · prepaid only · dispatch within 2 working days.

products.title: Selling is Serving Tee
products.body_html:
ENRJI® – feel it, live it

Selling is Serving.

Stop apologising for the ask. If what you're offering genuinely changes someone's life, then selling isn't taking - it's serving. The moment that lands, the fear goes and the numbers follow.

This piece is for the entrepreneur, the closer, the coach who has stopped seeing sales as pressure and started seeing it as purpose. Built on the philosophy Sneh Desai has taught to thousands of business owners.

This isn't just clothing — it's a reminder to embody the energy you want to live with. Crafted in alignment with Sneh Desai's empowering philosophy, each piece blends premium comfort, durability, and timeless style.

Details

  • 100% combed cotton, 220 GSM
  • Bio-washed for warmth and elegance
  • Bold layered chest print — navy block type with a red script overlay
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and hem
  • Unisex regular fit

Whether at a seminar, in the gym, or simply living with purpose — ENRJI® helps you feel it and live it.
